name: koishi-plugin-multibot-groupwelcome

author: xiaolan20020118 <xiaolan20020118@gmail.com>

description.zh: 多 Bot 群组欢迎/退群消息 - 多个 Bot 共用同一实例，为每个 Bot 独立配置按群组的欢迎/退群消息，无需其他插件支持
description.en: Multi-bot group welcome/leave messages - configure per-group welcome and leave messages for every bot sharing one Koishi instance, with no extra plugins required
